Hi Ben / Marissa,

We received the supplier portal invite this morning but the onboarding bot rejected our email attachments when we responded. The portal returned the auto-reply: 'Attachment processing failed: invalid MIME header'. Our finance team needs the PO visible in the portal to match the W-9 for VAT reasons.

I attached the signed W-9 and the PO template to this reply — when they go through the portal ingestion, the portal shows the message but the attachments are missing (we see only a placeholder). Our IT checked the outbound SMTP and says mail headers look normal on our side; they suspect a rewrite at the inbound parsing stage.

Can you confirm whether the portal supports multipart/signed and if there are any known filters that strip Content-Disposition or rename filename headers? If it's easier, I can upload the files to DocuSign/Drive and share a link. We are trying to complete onboarding before Friday's cutover so AP can issue test PO.

Hi Anna — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the friction.

Quick update / ask:
- We saw an ingestion error on our side that correlates with a missing Content-Disposition header on one of the parts. Some mail agents inline-embed PDFs and omit filename headers which our parser previously tolerated but a recent change hardened the validation.
- Can you re-send the W-9 as a standard attachment (not inline) or paste a Drive/DocuSign link? That will let us attach the doc to your profile immediately.
- I'm looping in Marissa (on vendor operations) and Laura (platform onboarding) to get a short-term bypass if needed.

If you can share a Drive or DocuSign link we will pull the file and attach it manually so the portal shows PO visibility. If you prefer we can also ask engineering to relax the specific validation check for this vendor while we onboard you. Which do you prefer?

Thanks,
